_sources: Gmail personal account limit ~500 recipients/day is a ceiling, not a target (Google: Gmail sending limits; Email sender guidelines FAQ support.google.com/mail/answer/14229414, enforcement gradual since Nov 2025)

WhatsApp publishes no daily limit for personal accounts; it is testing a monthly cap on messages to people who don't reply (TechCrunch 2025-10-17). Unofficial guidance: 20-30 new contacts/day max, start lower.
